name: Kagurabachi Battlegrounds
desc:
Become the peak of all shonen...

🖥️ Controls
G - Mode
F - Block
Q - Dash
Q (in ragdoll) - Ragdoll Cancel/Evasive
Double Tap W - run
Left Click - Punch
B - Emotes
R - Ragdoll
T - Pickup
M - Console Lock-on

Based off the manga Kagurabachi by Takeru Hokazono.
Release date: December 31, 2024
